title: A year of Riverbend Bike Share
brief: Hand-written example that uses every pattern of the demo template once. The organization and all its numbers are invented.

slots.title: Bikes became part of the daily commute
slots.subtitle: Weekday mornings now lead the week
body: In our first seasons most rides were weekend outings along the river. This year the busiest hour moved to eight on a weekday morning.
Riders told us why: the new docks sit next to the tram stops, so a bike covers the last stretch to work.

slots.title: What riders asked for
bulletList: Docks that are still free at nine in the morning
A pass that covers a whole family
Lights that stay on after a short stop
Clearer signs where the river path splits

slots.title: Three changes for next season
slots.card1Text: Bikes unlock from five in the morning, for early shifts and the first trams.
slots.card2Text: Every station gets lighting and a camera before the season opens.
slots.card3Text: One pass for up to five riders, bought once and shared by link.

slots.quoteText: I sold my second car in June. The bike gets me to the tram in six minutes, and I have not missed it once.
slots.quoteAuthor: A rider, in the end-of-season survey

slots.title: What we will decide in January
slots.subtitle: Three questions for the board
body: Whether next year's budget goes to new stations or to more bikes at the ones we have.
Whether the family pass replaces the day pass or sits beside it.
Whether the season opens in March, a month earlier than this year.
